verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials for an agent is a fair question for an agent-sandbox platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers general authentication: automatic OIDC auth on Vercel, development tokens via `vercel env pull`, and access tokens for non-Vercel environments. Nothing shows that these credentials can be scoped or limited to least-privilege permissions for an agent. The per-agent Linux user isolation is OS-level separation inside the sandbox, not API credential scoping, so it does not count here.
